title: 第9单元：应急响应
source_doc: course/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/04_Module 9 — Emergency Response.md
author_source: project/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/04_Module 9 — Emergency Response/src.py

points.K4: 应急箱放在伸手可及处
points.K5: 生物溢洒：先撤离再消毒
points.K9: 拿不准就撤，备好第二出口

shots.scene: 欣欣站在洗眼器和灭火器旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an eyewash station and a fire extinguisher on the wall and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲实验室出事时怎么应对。

shots.scene: 实验台、楼房、人体三个图标，中间有升级箭头
shots.prompt_en: Three icons linked by escalating arrows: a lab bench, a building and a human figure. No people.
shots.narration: 从台面，到楼里，到身上。

shots.scene: 警报灯闪烁，地上一摊液体和碎烧杯
shots.prompt_en: A warning light flashes in a lab; a broken beaker lies on the floor next to a spreading puddle of liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 警报响起，烧杯碎了一地。

shots.scene: 阿杰愣在原地，手足无措
shots.prompt_en: Wearing a lab coat and goggles, the young male student freezes in place, looking lost.
shots.narration: 阿杰愣住了：现在该干什么？

shots.scene: 小研冷静地拉着阿杰后退，伸手按下报警
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calmly pulls the young male student back and points toward the exit.
shots.narration: 小研拉他后退：先离开，再报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 应急，靠的是平时练出来的本能。

shots.scene: 书架上积灰的应急预案，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A dusty blank emergency plan binder on a shelf, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 预案放在架上，关键时刻没用。

shots.scene: 王老师带着学生演练，大家按路线走
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads students in an emergency drill, everyone walking along an evacuation route.
shots.narration: 要培训，要演练，练成本能。

shots.scene: 通风橱里一小摊液体，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: A small spill of liquid inside a fume hood with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 通风橱里洒了100毫升乙腈，可自行处理。

shots.scene: 地面上一大片液体，警示图标，人往外走
shots.prompt_en: A large spill spreading across the lab floor with a warning triangle, and a person icon walking out the door. No people.
shots.narration: 同样乙腈4升洒在地上，马上撤离。

shots.scene: 门口拉起警戒带，专业人员图标
shots.prompt_en: A lab doorway with a caution barrier tape across it and an icon of a responder in protective gear. No people.
shots.narration: 交给专业应急人员处理。

shots.scene: 打开的应急箱，里面有吸附棉、中和剂、袋子、夹子
shots.prompt_en: An open spill kit showing absorbent pads, neutralizer containers, a waste bag, tongs and gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 应急箱要按本实验室来配。

shots.scene: 生物危害袋、消毒剂、镊子图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a biohazard bag, a disinfectant bottle and forceps. No people.
shots.narration: 有生物材料，还要配消毒和锐器工具。

shots.scene: 小研对照空白化学品清单检查箱里的手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the gloves in the spill kit against a blank chemical inventory list.
shots.narration: 手套和防护，要对得上本室化学品。

shots.section_title: 应急箱放在伸手可及处
shots.scene: 应急箱挂在实验台旁边的墙上
shots.prompt_en: A spill kit mounted on the wall right next to the lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 应急箱放在伸手可及的地方。
overlay: 应急箱放在伸手可及处

shots.section_title: 应急箱放在伸手可及处
shots.scene: 锁着的门、杂物堆里的箱子，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a locked door and a spill kit buried in a cluttered closet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 锁在柜里、埋在杂物下，等于没有。

shots.section_title: 生物溢洒：先撤离再消毒
shots.scene: 生物安全柜外地上一个打翻的培养瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tipped-over culture flask on the floor outside a biological safety cabinet with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 二级生物安全培养物洒在柜外，别擦。
overlay: 生物溢洒：先撤离再消毒

shots.section_title: 生物溢洒：先撤离再消毒
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰离开房间，关上门，门上贴警示
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student leave the room, close the door and put a biohazard warning sign on it.
shots.narration: 停下工作，撤出房间，关门警示。

shots.section_title: 生物溢洒：先撤离再消毒
shots.scene: 门外沙漏图标
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon next to a closed lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 等30分钟，让气溶胶沉降。

shots.section_title: 生物溢洒：先撤离再消毒
shots.scene: 小研穿戴防护，用消毒剂覆盖溢洒区
shots.prompt_en: Wearing a lab coat, goggles, a mask and double gloves, the female graduate student covers the spill area with paper towels and disinfectant.
shots.narration: 用1比10漂白剂，作用10分钟。

shots.scene: 碎温度计和汞珠图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a broken thermometer with small silver droplets. No people.
shots.narration: 温度计碎了，汞洒出来怎么办？

shots.scene: 吸尘器图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A vacuum cleaner icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能用吸尘器，会让汞散到空气里。

shots.scene: 汞齐化海绵、硫粉和密封容器
shots.prompt_en: An amalgamation sponge, a jar of sulfur powder and a sealed waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 用汞齐化海绵或硫粉收集，按危废处置。

shots.scene: 通宵开着的电热板旁一团纸巾冒火苗，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A hot plate left on overnight with a crumpled paper towel beside it catching a small flame, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 浸溶剂的纸巾丢在通宵电热板旁起火。

shots.scene: 整洁的台面，电热板关着，旁边定时器
shots.prompt_en: A clean, clear bench with a switched-off hot plate and a timer beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 台面清爽，热源远离可燃物。

shots.scene: 阿杰下班前关掉电热板和设备
shots.prompt_en: Before leaving, the young male student switches off the hot plate and other equipment.
shots.narration: 下班关通风橱和设备，加热用定时器。

shots.scene: 灭火器特写
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a fire extinguisher mounted on a wall with a fire extinguisher sign above it. No people.
shots.narration: 受过训练，才去扑救初起小火。

shots.scene: 四个步骤图标：拔销、瞄准、压把、扫射
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons in a row: pulling a pin, aiming a nozzle at the base of a small flame, squeezing a handle, sweeping side to side. No people.
shots.narration: 拔销、对准火根、压把、左右扫。

shots.scene: 王老师在空地上带学生练习灭火器
shots.prompt_en: Outdoors in an open area, the safety administrator coaches students practicing with a fire extinguisher on a training tray.
shots.narration: 平时多练，紧张时才不会乱。

shots.section_title: 拿不准就撤，备好第二出口
shots.scene: 火势变大，人形图标走向安全出口
shots.prompt_en: A growing fire icon while person icons walk toward an emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 火控制不住、拿不准，立即撤离。
overlay: 拿不准就撤，备好第二出口

shots.section_title: 拿不准就撤，备好第二出口
shots.scene: 主出口被一摊液体堵住，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A main exit door blocked by a large spill with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 一次泄漏约200人撤离，主出口被堵。

shots.section_title: 拿不准就撤，备好第二出口
shots.scene: 箭头转向另一扇安全出口
shots.prompt_en: An arrow turning toward a second door with an emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 要认清第二条疏散路线。

shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和紧急喷淋标志
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign and an emergency shower sign side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品溅进眼睛或身上，马上冲。

shots.scene: 阿杰在洗眼器前撑开眼睛冲洗，旁边时钟
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rinses his eyes at an eyewash station, holding his eyelids open, with a clock on the wall.
shots.narration: 撑开眼皮，连续冲洗15分钟。

shots.scene: 感觉好了就离开的小人图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person walking away early from an eyewash station, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不是感觉好了就停，也不是水清就停。

shots.scene: 小研扶着阿杰站在洗眼器前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student supports the young male student at the eyewash station while he rinses.
shots.narration: 浓硝酸溅脸，同事硬拉他冲满15分钟。

shots.scene: 老周在旁边打电话呼叫急救
shots.prompt_en: Nearby, the older man makes a phone call for medical help.
shots.narration: 同时，有人呼叫急救。

shots.scene: 眼睛图标打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: An eye icon with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 温水下冲满时间，角膜保住了。

shots.scene: 针头图标和一滴血
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a syringe needle next to a single drop of blood. No people.
shots.narration: 处理人血浆时被针扎到？

shots.scene: 小研在水龙头下冲洗手指
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student rinses her finger under running water at a sink.
shots.narration: 立即在流水下彻底冲洗伤口。

shots.scene: 时间轴：冲洗、报告、就医三个节点
shots.prompt_en: A timeline with three nodes: running water, a blank report form and a hospital cross. No people.
shots.narration: 数小时内报告，确认暴露源。

shots.scene: 医院图标和时钟
shots.prompt_en: A hospital icon next to a clock. No people.
shots.narration: 尽快就医，评估是否需要预防用药。

shots.scene: 阿杰坐在长椅上，神情低落
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits on a bench looking anxious and downcast.
shots.narration: 经历事故，人会害怕、焦虑。

shots.scene: 王老师坐在他身边耐心交谈
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator sits beside him and talks gently.
shots.narration: 及时疏导，提供心理援助。

shots.scene: 身体和心形图标并排打勾
shots.prompt_en: A body icon and a heart icon side by side, both with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 心里的恢复，和身体一样重要。

shots.scene: 时钟和空白报告单图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a clock and a blank incident report form. No people.
shots.narration: 按美国职业安全监管，死亡8小时内上报。

shots.scene: 病床、包扎的手臂、眼睛图标和24小时钟
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a hospital bed, a bandaged arm and an eye, next to a 24-hour clock. No people.
shots.narration: 住院、截肢、失去眼睛，24小时内。

shots.scene: 相机图标对着事故现场
shots.prompt_en: A camera icon pointed at an accident scene with a broken flask on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 最初几小时最关键，保护证据拍照。

shots.scene: 王老师向小研了解经过，做记录
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator interviews the female graduate student and takes notes on a blank form.
shots.narration: 趁记忆清楚，赶在换班前问证人。

shots.scene: 涉事设备贴上停用标签
shots.prompt_en: A piece of lab equipment with a blank out-of-service tag. No people.
shots.narration: 涉事设备先停用隔离。

shots.scene: 放大镜从人形图标移到时钟和规程图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass moving from a person icon to a clock icon and a blank procedure sheet icon. No people.
shots.narration: 调查要找系统原因。

shots.scene: 规程上缺了一步，空白处被补上
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure sheet with a missing step, then a new step being added. No people.
shots.narration: 分析员赶工跳步，改的是规程不是人。

shots.scene: 指责的手指图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A blaming pointing finger icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只怪个人，以后就没人敢报告。

shots.scene: 一张空白新规定被塞进柜子，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A blank new rule sheet being stuffed into a filing cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 写完规定归档，不算整改。

shots.scene: 老李在通风橱旁加装定时开关，小研检查
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer installs a timer switch next to a hot plate while the female graduate student checks it.
shots.narration: 真正改变做法，事故才不会再来。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在应急箱旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a wall-mounted spill kit.
shots.narration: 看规模定应对，应急箱随手可取。

shots.scene: 生物危害标志和汞处理包图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a biohazard warning sign and a mercury spill kit. No people.
shots.narration: 生物溢洒先撤离，汞别用吸尘器。

shots.scene: 灭火器和安全出口图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fire extinguisher and an emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 四步灭小火，拿不准就撤。

shots.scene: 洗眼器和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an eyewash station and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 冲洗15分钟，严重事件限时上报。

shots.scene: 放大镜和循环箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a magnifying glass and a circular loop arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 查系统原因，整改要闭环。

shots.scene: 欣欣和小研、阿杰在演练集合点挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye with the female graduate student and the young male student at an assembly point.
shots.narration: 平时多演练，危急不慌乱，下次见！
